2025arXiv251213591C.title: astroCAMP: A Community Benchmark and Co-Design Framework for Sustainable SKA-Scale Radio Imaging

execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Framework definition (WSClean+IDG matrix skips computing quality scores)

psnr_details.evidence: Table 2 names PSNR as a core quality metric via 10 log₁₀(I_max²/MSE) vs reference (scikit-image / OpenCV style). PSNR appears in the co-design quality tuple with dirty-image RMS and DR, but Section 6 does not tabulate PSNR for the WSClean+IDG experimental release.

2022MNRAS.514.2614C.title: Deep radio-interferometric imaging with POLISH: DSA-2000 and weak lensing

psnr_details.scope: DSA-2000 full-band sim (1300 MHz, 15 min PSF; 50 validation images)

execution_context.formulation: PSNR in dB (pixel-wise truth; integer-range normalised)
execution_context.max_definition: Normalised to available integer range before evaluation

psnr_details.evidence: Full-band: POLISH mean PSNR 55.9±4.7 dB vs CLEAN 50.0±6.0 dB. Narrow-band snapshot PSF: POLISH 55.1±3.8 dB vs CLEAN 47.4±3.6 dB. Real VLA transfer is qualitative only — no PSNR on observed data.

psnr_details.scope: POLISH vs image-plane CLEAN on DSA-2000 validation

execution_context.frequency: 1300 MHz full-band (+7.7 dB on 10 MHz narrow-band)

psnr_details.evidence: Reported mean PSNR improvements: +5.9 dB (full-band) and +7.7 dB (narrow-band) over image-plane CLEAN on the same 50-image validation set.
POLISH mean PSNR (~55 dB) exceeds CLEAN (~47–50 dB) on both full-band and narrow-band DSA-2000 simulations.

psnr_details.scope: PSF-mismatch ablation: train γ∈[0,20], test to γ=30 and 1.4× radial stretch

execution_context.image_domain: Normalized images under synthetic PSF warp

psnr_details.evidence: PSNR decreases outside the training warp distribution but remains above 50 dB across the displayed 3×3 γ / stretch grid.
Network minimizes pixel-wise ℓ1 loss; model checkpoints are selected by validation PSNR.

2025arXiv250309559C.title: Interlaced R2D2 DNN Series for Scalable Non-Cartesian MRI with Sensitivity Self-calibration

execution_context.max_definition: M = max pixel value; N = image size

psnr_details.evidence: iR2D2(U-WDSR) achieves 40.21±6.67 dB; other reported means include R2D2 35.08±4.67, R2D2-Net 36.46±5.23, U-WDSR 34.38±4.19, NC-PDNet 34.11±5.01, DDS 33.73±6.80, iR2D2(U-Net) 38.01±6.57 dB.

psnr_details.scope: iR2D2(U-WDSR) vs R2D2(U-WDSR) from interlaced self-calibration

execution_context.max_definition: M = max pixel; N = image size

psnr_details.evidence: +5.13 dB mean gain over R2D2(U-WDSR); advantage largest (~6 dB) in the high dynamic-range regime. Also ~6 dB over NC-PDNet and ~6.5 dB over DDS.
iR2D2(U-WDSR) reports the highest mean PSNR among listed baselines (R2D2, R2D2-Net, U-WDSR, NC-PDNet, DDS).

2026A&A...706A..77M.title: Accelerating the CLEAN algorithm of radio interferometry with convex optimization

psnr_details.scope: Synthetic Cygnus A and ENZO simulation reconstructions

execution_context.image_domain: Linear image intensity vs reconstruction θ

psnr_details.evidence: Linear PSNR defined as 20 log₁₀(max(I)/‖θ−I‖). CG-CLEAN and Momentum-CLEAN score highest on synthetic Cygnus A and ENZO; CG-CLEAN leads overall vs standard CLEAN.

psnr_details.scope: Synthetic Cygnus A and ENZO (faint/diffuse emphasis)
psnr_details.evidence: Log-domain PSNR emphasises diffuse/faint emission fidelity. CG-CLEAN and Momentum-CLEAN score highest on both PSNR variants; not classified under the separate logSNR column.

psnr_details.scope: Synthetic Cygnus A and ENZO PSNR / PSNR_log
psnr_details.evidence: CG-CLEAN outperforms Momentum-CLEAN and standard CLEAN overall on both linear PSNR and PSNR_log.

2026arXiv260115844M.title: Radio-Interferometric Image Reconstruction with Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models

psnr_details.scope: DDRM VLA config at K=1000 sampling steps (flux-normalised)
psnr_details.evidence: VLA K-sweep: PSNR 45.0 (K=10) → 49.9 → 51.8 → 59.8 → 62.9 (K=1000). EHT K=1000: 61.7 dB; ALMA K=1000: 62.8 dB. Reported alongside MSE/SNR/SRE.

psnr_details.scope: PSNR vs diffusion sampling steps K on VLA config
psnr_details.evidence: PSNR rises monotonically with sampling steps K from 45.0 dB at K=10 to 62.9 dB at K=1000; K=1000 used for subsequent telescope configs.

2026arXiv260309162W.title: POLISH'ing the Sky: Wide-Field and High-Dynamic Range Interferometric Image Reconstruction with Application to Strong Lens Discovery

execution_context.formulation: PSNR in dB (pixel-level fidelity under PSF warp)
execution_context.image_domain: Reconstructed images under synthetic PSF warping

psnr_details.evidence: PSNR degrades predictably as PSF warp γ increases outside training (γ=0 only). Authors note PSNR is more sensitive to model mismatch than visual quality, which remains comparatively stable even at γ=30.

psnr_details.scope: Fine-tuning under PSF mismatch vs train-from-scratch
psnr_details.baseline: Train from scratch (57 epochs to peak PSNR)
psnr_details.evidence: Fine-tuning an existing POLISH++ model reaches peak PSNR in 11 epochs vs 57 epochs training from scratch (>5× speedup); both beat the unadapted mismatched baseline. No head-to-head PSNR vs R2D2 on shared data.
